title: Mum asks: memory
hook: Mum asked: why does AI forget me?

beats.say: Mum says her AI forgot her name after a long chat.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Beta the AI forgot my NAME. We were talking for 2 hours!!

beats.say: It's like the family group. Three hundred unread messages, and you only read the last few.
The AI can only hold so much. In a long chat, the start falls off.
Tip! Start a new chat, and tell it who you are!

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Beta the AI forgot my NAME. We were talking for 2 hours!!

This is why I sign every message. Love, Mummy

beats.say: She says that's why she signs every message. Love, Mummy.

caption:
mum asked why AI forgets. turns out she solved it years ago. love, mummy.
